constraints.statement: SemanticLayerToolkit.__init__ is `def __init__(self, **kwargs: Any) -> None` (toolkit.py:44) — kwargs-only, no named params. `static_subject` raises static_subject_forbidden (:67); a governed model without dataplane_guard raises guard_required (:79); sl_run_sql is hidden unless allow_raw_sql=True (:104,:469); sl_save_result_as_dataset is hidden without a dataset_manager_factory.

An LLM-DRIVEN example must do BOTH `async with bind_semantic_context(ctx, identity=...)` AND `await agent.ask(q, permission_context=ctx)`. _pre_execute fail-closes unless the _permission_context kwarg equals current_pctx(), and that kwarg only arrives via AbstractBot.ask(permission_context=...). Direct method calls (what today's example does) bypass _pre_execute entirely.
SemanticQuery is ConfigDict(extra="forbid") (models.py:105). Every field name in an example must be copied from the model, never guessed.
A GovernedDatasetSink may NOT be an AbstractToolkit/DatasetManager/DataFrame — _validate_sink rejects it by MRO. The existing example works around this with a _FacadeSink composition wrapper.

Do NOT name any new example file test_*.py. pytest.ini sets no testpaths/norecursedirs and there is no root collect_ignore, so examples/ IS collected — examples/agents/ already holds five test_*.py files with pytest __pycache__.
examples/**/*.py is ruff-ignored for ONLY F401/F841/E402 (ruff.toml:152). TID251 (banned imports incl. sidemantic), B, ASYNC, PIE, C4, LOG all still bite, at line-length 120.

CI's only semantic exposure is ci.yml:535-536 — `uv sync --all-packages --extra duckdb` then pytest on packages/ai-parrot-semantic/tests, with no --continue-on-collection-errors. New examples should be DuckDB-only or importorskip-guarded.
compile_query returns PRE-RLS SQL (closed issue:22fbd14d96a9); governed SQL lives only in the audit record. An example printing compile_query output must not call it 'the SQL as executed'.

issue:f0da823294fb (major, closed) forced the current example's real DataPlanePolicyGuard, connection_env(), owner pre-check and failing-denial demo. Re-introducing a placeholder guard, env leak, weak owner check or missing denial in a NEW example is a known regression.
docs/tools/semantic-layer.md's YAML/JSON code blocks are parsed by packages/ai-parrot-semantic/tests/test_mcp_local.py:26 (_DOC_PATH). Editing that doc's fenced blocks is a test-affecting change.
Usage rights restrict ONLY masked columns / sensitive:true members (closed issue:9a4e4c35b032). The current example's `usage:` list is broader than required and should not be copied as 'required'.

A policy model covers only its own table, relationship-reachable tables, and tables its own masks/rls name (closed issue:bd477252b8f3). A multi-model example MUST declare the relationship or qualification fails.
RlsRegistry has no unregister API (closed issue:e3ff9bfb4a83) — reload() never drops an RLS rule. No example may present reload() as a way to remove one.

parrot.semantic.__init__ exports ONLY __version__, SemanticQuery, SemanticQueryResult, SemanticLayerToolkit (:7). Everything else (context, handoff, results, bootstrap, errors) must be imported from its submodule.
The public surface has been frozen since 2026-10-26, but that day landed four BEHAVIOURAL fixes (c3e2049d, 32a7762e, 0ac26316, ae7e21f1). Examples must be written against post-c3e2049d semantics.
